payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over positions with h[i]!=h[i+1], tracking sum of -1/0/1 diff contributions, then counting sequences with positive total sum.
payload.rationale: The problem reduces to independent choices for positions where adjacent h differ, with diff in {-1,0,1}. Sequential DP computes distribution of sum; dp_interval is the closest DP subtype among candidates.
